configuration: All five upstream cases of unittest/energy.cpp on the frozen model and operands.
observable: the kinetic, potential and mechanical energy, with the inertia matrix and centre of mass they are built from
default_vs_upstream: upstream, except that one frozen model replaces the per-case random draws
variant: Two units in the last place, toward positive infinity, on nine active initial-condition numbers. Six are operands: one free-flyer orientation coordinate and one joint angle of each frozen configuration (q[3], q[7], q_alt[3], q_alt[7]) and the first velocity coordinate of each (v[0], v_alt[0]). Three are model numbers, because the model is itself an initial-condition input and some graded quantities depend on it alone: the mass and the first lever component of the first body, and the leading rotation entry of the root joint's placement. That set was chosen by measurement, through four corrections. A joint angle alone is erased wherever a case overwrites q.tail(nq-7) before computing. A free-flyer translation alone is inert, rigid-body dynamics being invariant under translation of the floating base. A base orientation alone cannot reach a case that zeroes gravity, which is then invariant under base rotation too, and no operand at all reaches a total mass. No inertial number reaches a Jacobian, which is why the root placement is perturbed as well, that being the one placement premultiplying the whole tree; perturbing its translation was rejected because it is zero and two ulps above zero is a subnormal, and perturbing a mid-tree placement was rejected because it reaches only that joint's descendants. The worst measured spread is 1.7053e-13 absolute. 4 of the 15 observables show a spread of exactly zero and are insensitive by construction, not by accident: against_rnea_kinetic_energy, kinetic_energy, potential_energy_com_form, total_mass. Each is either a single scalar, whose last bit does not move under a relative input change of about 1e-16, or a quantity that depends only on the model's masses, which the variant perturbs but not enough to change the rounded result. Their bound therefore rests on the physical argument in the warrant rather than on a measured sensitivity, and the curator should read it as such.
altbuild: none: the same source built at -O0 with -ffp-contract=off reproduces the -O2 result bit-identically for this module, so an alternative build measures a floor of exactly zero and supplies no evidence. Eigen fixes the evaluation order of these expressions and the recursions are scalar, so the compiler has nothing to reassociate.

evidence.floor_how: The same official.cpp compiled twice against the same pinned source, once at -O2 -DNDEBUG and once at -O0 -ffp-contract=off, and run on ic/nominal; every graded value was bit-identical, so the measured floor is 0.0 and the bound is set from the variant spread and the physics instead.

warrant: The graded quantities are the kinetic, potential and mechanical energy of the system and the power the joint torques inject, in SI units and in the model's own degree-of-freedom, joint or Cartesian-axis order, which is fixed by the frozen model rather than chosen by the implementation. The bound is 1e-09 absolute plus 1e-11 relative, so on the largest graded magnitude here, about 6.87e+02, it admits about 7.87e-09. It is physical because every implementation fault this test can express is many orders of magnitude larger: omitting a body from the kinetic sum, using the wrong sign on gravity, or dropping the armature from the inertia, each of which moves individual values by between 1e-1 and 1e2 in these units, seven to ten decades above the bound; and the upstream identities, which compare two independent routes to the same quantity, stay active as well, so such a fault is rejected twice over. It is achievable because a correct port that reassociates the recursion differs by about n*eps*|x|, roughly 32 * 2.2e-16 * 1e3, near 7e-12, three decades inside the bound. Measured on this host: the two-ulp variant moves the worst graded value by 1.7053e-13, using 5.938e-05 of the bound, that is 16,840 times of headroom across all 1071 graded values, and the alternative build measured exactly zero. The bound is loose enough for a genuinely different implementation on another device and tight enough that no fault the upstream test is written to catch could pass it.
